title_cyr: Свадба се прави в' Скудриње село
title_latin: Svadba se pravi v' Skudrinje selo
title_en: A Wedding Is Held in Skudrinje Village
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear. 'ливаѓе' read as 'meadow' and 'избегала' as 'ran away': my reading. Skudrinje, Zhirovnitsa and the Radika are in the Reka region.

lines.cyr: Свадба се прави в' Скудриње село
lines.lat: Svadba se pravi v' Skudrinje selo
lines.en: A wedding is held in Skudrinje village,

lines.cyr: да појдиме мајко, колку е весело.
lines.lat: da pojdime majko, kolku e veselo.
lines.en: let us go, mother, how merry it is.

lines.cyr: сè е накитено, в' ново облечено.
lines.lat: sè e nakiteno, v' novo oblečeno.

lines.en: Fata ran away, a young orphan,
from our place, the village of Zhirovnitsa.
The drums beat, the zurnas wail,
in the meadow nearby, wrestlers fight.

lines.cyr: Гости ни дојдоа од рекански села,
lines.lat: Gosti ni dojdoa od rekanski sela,
lines.en: Guests came to us from the Reka villages,

lines.cyr: песните се слушаат по Радика цела.
lines.lat: pesnite se slušaat po Radika cela.
lines.en: songs are heard all along the Radika.
From small, Fata was left an orphan,

lines.cyr: татко, мајка, Фата не си прегрнала.
lines.lat: tatko, majka, Fata ne si pregrnala.
